tasks.title: Azure Planner Path Baseline Validation
tasks.notes: Run real Azure path with representative prompts; collect and replay provider traces; record fixtures for regression.

tasks.title: World Scan — prismarine-chunk 1.21.x Compatibility
tasks.notes: Test readRegionBlocks against local spigot-1.21.1.jar world files. If incompatible evaluate direct NBT parsing or plugin-side scan endpoint. Until verified, view requests outside initial payload return graceful scan-unavailable.

tasks.title: Execution UX and Job Control
tasks.notes: Progress/status messaging, per-step failure surfacing, cancellation semantics. Coordinate with refinement-loop and undo design. Recommended after task 16 (Azure baseline) so messaging targets real failure modes — not a hard code dependency.

tasks.title: Benchmark and Evaluation Harness
tasks.notes: Repeatable scenario fixtures, automatic scoring for structural validity / terrain intrusion / palette diversity / budget. Use for baseline-vs-new comparisons (pairs well with task 16 but does not require 16 to be done first).

tasks.title: Bug: parseRequestedBlock silently ignores ids after the first
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Returns only first matched minecraft: id; multi-block messages lose later ids. Document before expanding material resolution.

tasks.title: Bug: managedBlocks unbounded cache in BridgeServer
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Never evicts. Fine for dev session; add max-size cap or session-scoped reset for long-running server.

tasks.title: Nearby Build Preservation
tasks.notes: Detect likely player-made nearby structures. Add avoidance/protection policies during planning and execution. Requires world scan (17) and stable terrain/context (23).

tasks.title: Conversation history context for follow-on prompts
tasks.notes: The orchestrator already maintains recentMessagesByPlayer (last 10 messages) and passes them to the AI as recentMessages. The gap is that the AI prompt does not strongly instruct the model to treat these as a running conversation and resolve follow-on intent from them. Also, the last built plan is passed as lastBuiltStructure but the AI may not reliably use it. Improvements: (1) prompt should explicitly say treat recentMessages as your conversation history — resolve ambiguous follow-ups like taller, move it, use oak, that one against this context; (2) consider summarising the last built plan in a human-readable line rather than raw JSON so it is easier for the AI to reference; (3) add an integration test that sends a follow-up prompt and verifies the AI references prior context in its plan. Optional: run task 16 baseline after changes to measure follow-up quality — not required to start implementation.
